verdict.rationale: The only scheduling capability in the evidence is recurring invoices at a chosen frequency (docs-14). Categorization rules (docs-4) and continuous auto-reconciliation (supp-auto-rec) are rule-based automation, not user-scheduled jobs. The API and MCP layer that could enable AI-driven scheduled workflows are only announced as coming 'soon' (docs-10, docs-11). Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows beyond invoices, a shipped API/MCP for agent-driven automation, AI-assistant (Command) scheduling, and independent corroboration.
